name: letter-pullup
title: Letter Pullup
blurb: Letters pull up from the bottom into view sequentially.
description: Each character starts below the text baseline and animates up into place with staggered timing.
use_when: Dramatic entrance animations for section titles or hero text.
avoid_when: Quick-loading pages — the animation delay makes content feel slow to arrive.
a11y: Text is hidden below the viewport until animation completes; screen readers may announce before visible.
